outcome: mean number of fills per person
mean filled morphine milligram equivalents (MMEs) per day
percentage of patients filling a prescription for a schedule II opioid
percentage of patients filling a prescription for a schedule III or higher opioid
cohort: 460,371 privately insured postpartum women who delivered a singleton live newborn between July 1, 2018, and December 31, 2020
finding: This cross-sectional study suggests that the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic was associated with significant increases in postpartum opioid fills.
mod_finding: The observed increases in opioid fills were larger for patients who delivered by cesarean birth than those delivering vaginally.
